scope: P3-144 bounded Work and non-medical Health Current State disclosure on the retained LifeOS Settings shell

transitions.persistent_effect: noncontent receipt and tested model identifiers only; selected model must remain unset
selected model only after an explicit confirmation action
source references, disclosure audit and pending understanding only
superseded item excluded from every later disclosure
ciphertext, reference, Keychain item and enablement invalidated

invariants: Phase A is hard-pinned to synthetic mode; a future real gate may use only DeepSeek at https://api.deepseek.com after separate approval.

At most three relevant, active, authorized items from exactly one domain may be previewed before a one-time confirmation; no item body is included in Evidence.
Credential or authentication failure blocks before network activity and keeps the provider disabled.
